thesis: Mohnish Pabrai explains that becoming financially independent at age 33 allowed him to pursue a more independent path and spend more time investing rather than managing his own business. He states that managing other people's money has not been stressful for him, though he feels sadness when investors redeem at market bottoms, and he views his concentrated Turkish investment as a family business he intends to own forever.
